sections.name: mission
sections.value: Join current native session and register true identity/capability; native outgoing pij_send tool; serialized blocking inbox consumer, durable acceptance before ack, reconnect/abort/session rollover and honest errors/events. No automatic reply forwarding. PM pij-grim-gurgeh personally owns plan and implementation guide; do not write/revise either. Fill the frozen contract and report evidence/necessary corrections to PM.

value.text: Read plan.dd.md, impl-guide.dd.md unit extension, assets/contracts/native-extension.json, assets/backpressure.dd.md and assets/inputs/prime-constraints-2026-09-05.md IN YOUR WORKTREE. Use absolute paths. C10 wire discipline from skill://pij.

ACK before code: report your exact worktree/branch, actual harness/model/configured effort, numbered execution steps, interface mismatches, and any unknown affecting proof. Wait for PM ack approval before source edits. Do not author a competing plan/guide.

Use /builder implementation discipline. Contract-first targeted tests; every negative witness must demonstrably catch a plausible defect. Run scoped tests in YOUR isolated tree; skip project-wide builds/lint/test gates during concurrent wave. PM owns final gate. No new dependencies/toolchain upgrades; worktree-local Cargo target. Never run legacy TS daemon or flowspace3 daemon.

Stay strictly in scope fence. Do not edit core/src/delivery.rs, harnesses/src/interaction.rs or .pi extension-side hold queue (plan136). Register response additive to135. If frozen interface insufficient, stop only dependent work and send precise evidence to PM, no private sibling renegotiation.

Dogfood actual flowspace3 CLI search/get for meaning-shaped code questions; read skill://flowspace first. Use native LSP references/refactors where available. Report CLI/tool gaps, not silent substitution. Exact text grep is fine.

Unit acceptance: node:test through proposed just copilot-native-test (installer owner provides recipe). Inject runtime/HTTP/storage for deterministic lifecycle/crash/duplicate and capability protocol tests; no new dependencies. Receiver consumes daemon-owned consent decision, never implements competing typing policy. Test buffered user/assistant events do not create auto-reply loop.

Commit explicit paths only with conventional commit; no -A, no bypass hooks, no push/main merge. Record commands, versions, result IDs and assumptions in your assets/evidence/runtime-receipt.json or .md. Do not mark PM ACs complete; return commit SHA + unit evidence + remaining integration needs.

Do NOT copy scratch PoC automatic assistant-reply forwarding into product. Incoming data must remain data. Never claim native acknowledgement means completed model work. No real global setup/restart; only isolated test homes and processes you own.

Status now at start/end via Pij; runtime discovery and actual canary already requested. Model github-copilot/gpt-6-astra-1m high, OMP. Do not update OMP: local Astra patches required. If missing thinking/API error, report to PM.
PM pij-grim-gurgeh owns contract, plan, guide and convergence. Send questions/done there using native pij_send; no modal UI. Other coders are isolated and must not share source writes.
Prime pij-minor-unicorn owns136/135 overlap; PM coordinates shared-file convergence. Do not request global restarts or alter governance.
